title: He Lost His Mother on 9/11. He Grew Up in Her Childhood Bedroom.
summary: Jacob Campbell was a baby when his mother was killed, and he has struggled to come to terms with the tragedy that shaped him. For the grandmother who raised him, it’s even harder.
